issues.title: Avatar skeleton vertical misalignment
issues.description: Avatar skeleton is misaligned with the accompanying text skeleton lines.
issues.evidence: Circular avatar starts below the top edge of the first horizontal skeleton line.
issues.suggestion: Align the top of the avatar skeleton with the top text skeleton line.
issues.triageNote: Root cause is pair-013's inline composition (src/app/eval/pair-013/page.tsx ~L85): a 40px avatar Skeleton centered against a 3-line text column (3×16px + 2×8px gap = 64px) via items-center, so the avatar top sits 12px below the first line. The component and its demo (ui-demos/skeleton/avatar.tsx: 2 lines = 40px = avatar) align exactly. Eval pages are QA-owned and not editable — one-line fix for the orchestrator: items-center → items-start on that flex row.

extraFixes.title: Skeleton invisible on panel/card surfaces in dark theme
extraFixes.description: Skeleton used bg-accent, which in dark theme resolves to --ds-color-neutral-100 = rgb(21 21 19) — exactly --ds-color-panel. Loading rows on Cards/panels (e.g. pair-172 skeleton table rows, pair-147 host/extras block on bg-card, sidebar menu loading) rendered at zero contrast in dark mode.
extraFixes.fix: src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx: base class now 'bg-accent dark:bg-neutral-200 animate-pulse rounded-md' — dark skeleton is one step above the panel on the inverted neutral scale (rgb(42 41 38) on rgb(21 21 19)), mirroring the light-theme accent-on-white relationship. Note: dark:bg-neutral-800 was considered and rejected (neutral-800 is near-white rgb(221 217 207) in dark).
